newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul party chief urges re-think on N.Korea policy.
newsitem.headline: Seoul party chief urges re-think on N.Korea policy.

text.p: South Korea's ruling party chairman on Wednesday said Seoul must re-think its policy towards North Korea with the Stalinist state facing its biggest ever crisis.
Lee Hong-koo of the New Korea Party said the defection by top ideologue Hwang Jang-yop was pushing the North Korean leadership deeper into desperation.
"Severe food shortages and economic difficulties are driving the North Korean system to an irreversible final crisis," Lee told parliament.
"In view of North Korea's rapid breaking away from its orbit and its plunge, we must drastically review our unification policy," he said.

South Korean officials have said problems stemming from the defection of Hwang, a top advisor to North Korean leader Kim Jong-il, were just the start of headaches for Seoul. Hwang remains at the South Korean mission in Beijing.
